incident-bot: ALERT: error rate spike on inference route rwkv-gen > 5% (service=redwood-gen, model=rwkv-large-q2) at 2025-07-13T03:12:01Z — paging oncall
olivia: paging in. seeing a flurry of 5xx and repeated \"kv cache: allocation failed\" messages across a subset of nodes. Deployed quantized model last night? :rotating_light:
mike: can confirm there was a quantize rollout overnight. pulling deploy history now.
-deployer: ci pipeline applied model-quantize:v2 -> rwkv-large-q2 at 2025-07-13T01:40Z
sarah: telemetry: token perplexity drift and intermittent OOMs on GPU nodes g-12/g-14. Affects both streaming and non-streaming callers.
olivia: mitigation plan proposal: 1) shift traffic to rwkv-large-fp16 fallback, 2) disable kv-cache on the q2 instances, 3) reduce max batch on latency-sensitive routes.
mike: executing step 1 now: `redwoodctl routes update --route rwkv-gen --model rwkv-large-fp16 --confirm`
mike: step 2 flush/disable KV cache for quantized model: `curl -X POST \"https://console.api/redwood/admin/cache/flush?model=rwkv-large-q2\" -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN\"` -> 202 Accepted. Error rates starting to decline.
olivia: step 3 applied to chat-low-latency route: `redwoodctl routes update --route chat-low-latency --max-batch 1` to avoid batching head-of-line and memory spikes.
oncall-ryan: joining. node logs show CUDA OOMs and allocator fragmentation warnings. Garbage collection thrashing on the in-process KV cache.
infra-bot: Autoscaler: triggered add_nodes for pool-dedicated; +2 GPUs at 03:18 UTC, but the root cause is memory fragmentation not pure capacity.
sarah: customer impact assessment: ~8 organizations saw degraded responses or 5xx between 03:10-03:18 UTC. Most recovered after failover. No data leakage. Notified SOC.
support: copy of status update posted to #support-drafts: \"Brief degradation—traffic routed to fallback. Post-incident summary forthcoming.\" :white_check_mark:
mike: monitoring: error rate back to baseline for primary routes. RPC p95 on fallback is +30ms. Quantized nodes still emitting `kv cache eviction storm` warnings when they serve any requests.
olivia: leaving handoff for next oncall. Ryan -> Anita. Ryan, can you own rollback coordination + postmortem initiator?
oncall-ryan: taking multi-hour stabilization. Immediate runbook: cordon quantized instances, revert quantize rollout from canary->global (ticket INF-4523), run a KV cache GC audit and reproduce OOM locally.
anita: I will run postmortem. Scheduling: 2025-07-13 16:00 UTC for initial RCA. Ill create calendar + doc template.
olivia: assigning action items (tracking in-thread):
- olivia: confirm rollback and coordinate with deployer (due 2025-07-13T06:00Z)
- mike: build repro for quantization conversion and provide minimal test case (due 2025-07-20)
- sarah: add telemetry/perplexity drift alert for quantized-model rollouts (due 2025-07-17)
- ryan: KV cache GC root-cause + mitigation (eviction policy or backpressure) (due 2025-07-21)
- anita: schedule postmortem, collect logs, draft timeline, create JIRA INF-4523 (due 2025-07-14)
mike: preliminary notes for ticket: quantization tensor packing change increased allocator fragmentation for our in-process KV cache; combined with batch-size increase (8->32) created memory storms and OOMs under common hot-key patterns.
sarah: short-term rollout guard checklist I'm adding:
- require canary quantized deployments to set kv-cache=off for 24h
- run batch stress tests that mix cold-key hot-key patterns
- add perplexity and response-dist alerts comparing 24h baseline
anita: created INF-4523: \"rwkv-large-q2 quantize rollout -> KV cache OOMs & batching regressions\" https://jira.company/browse/INF-4523
anita: calendar invite: https://calendar.company/meet/pm-1757894321 — agenda: timeline, RCA, mitigations, owners, follow-ups.
olivia: posted SOC/AM communication draft in ticket for targeted outreach to impacted customers.
oncall-ryan: handing live supervision off to Anita at 04:00 UTC. State: fallback model active, autoscaler stable, quantized model paused, error rate normalized. I'll be on-call for immediate escalations for 1 more hour.
anita: taking over. next tasks: collect full GPU allocator traces, run GC-policy experiments in staging, add a temporary pre-check that blocks quantized rollouts if kv-cache memory delta in canary > 20%.
mike: long-term remediation proposals to add to INF-4523 checklist:
- allocation-safety checks in quantize pipeline to detect packing changes that increase fragmentation
- end-to-end regression tests for batching + kv-cache interactions (simulate hot-keys)
- rollout health gating on both latency and perplexity metrics, not just error-rate
sarah: adding owners + ETAs into INF-4523. Will follow up with telemetry PR for perplexity alerting. :memo:
anita: initial postmortem doc created at https://docs.company/incidents/INF-4523/postmortem — I'll paste a first draft after log collection and timeline reconstruction.
olivia: appreciate the rapid response. Please update INF-4523 as you make progress. High priority. :pray:
incident-bot: Incident severity set to Sev2 -> moving to post-incident review. Thread closed for live mitigation at 04:12 UTC.
